response.overview: In 2021, Tokyo is under a state of emergency. While massive social shifts unfold around him, Leo (Taisei Sakai)—a young man adrift without a job, a home, or even a smartphone—spends his days consumed by romance, jealousy, self-absorption, and aimless conversations with friends. Caught between a friend diving into social activism, an uncompromising activist, and a university professor resistant to change, Leo struggles to define his place in a world he barely understands, masking his insecurities behind endless, hollow chatter in front of three women: his devoted ex-girlfriend, a patient female friend, and Anna, an aspiring actress he falls for at first sight. Five years later in 2026, revisiting Leo's memories reveals not a bygone era, but a lingering sense of stagnation that continues to define modern society.
response.tagline: 緊急事態宣言下、東京を漂う青年と、三人の女たち。
response.title: Raiden
